scorer.authority: Every execution has a globally unique regime/case invocation ID. Checkpoint choice, completed payload restoration, reset/invalidation behavior, and normalized evaluator coverage are derived from raw inventory and ordered primitive receipts.

lineage.wire: Full UTF-8 bytes plus the production-tokenizer token-end byte map; zero-width control tokens may produce equal adjacent offsets, but offsets never decrease and the final offset covers all wire bytes.
lineage.canonical: The scorer decodes the complete canonical I32 token vector and validates the GLM vocabulary domain.
lineage.live: The scorer decodes the complete pre-load live I32 token vector and derives live length and common-prefix length; no caller common/live summary field exists.
lineage.restored: The decoded restored checkpoint vector must equal both canonical[:selected] and live[:selected].
lineage.checkpoint: A stored record's token and lineage hashes are both checkpoint-local hashes of canonical[:record.token_length], never hashes of a future prompt.

checkpoint_selection.formula: Select exactly one longest structurally valid record whose rendered wire prefix and checkpoint-local token lineage match and whose token length is at or before the scorer-derived common frontier. Equal-length eligible records reject as ambiguous.
checkpoint_selection.read_completion: Exactly one payload-read receipt must bind the selected record, token length, payload hash, and the formula-derived payload byte count. Zero, short, over, trailing, or multiple reads reject.

evaluation.receipt_shape: One or more ordered evaluator receipts are normalized only when their ranges are contiguous, nonempty, nonoverlapping, gap-free, and share the unique case invocation ID.
evaluation.rejections: Any hidden pre-checkpoint evaluation, gap, overlap, duplicate range, reset, or invalidation in the candidate rejects.

complete_state.acceptance: Names, dtypes, dimensions, ordering, offsets, byte counts, total formula, per-member hashes, manifest root, token lineage, and all 78 logical frontiers are scorer-derived and exact. Cold, strict, candidate, exact-off, and exact-on manifests must match exactly.

exact_replay.operations: Both flag-off and flag-on exact replay perform no load, reset, invalidation, or evaluation and retain the full canonical live lineage.
exact_replay.artifacts: Both carry the same complete state manifest, 154880 finite logits, argmax, and 64 generated tokens as cold/strict/candidate.

confirmation.selection: The post-freeze public-random digest and regime ID select disjoint variants 0-7 and 8-15. The frozen fixture builder appends the exact ASCII W7 confirmation-variant marker before production tokenization.
confirmation.binding: The scorer verifies the marker, seed-selected variant, canonical content hash over all fixture inputs, aggregate top-level hash, and pairwise-different decoded fixture content.
